sections.title: Welding Event Resources
body: Find resources to prepare for a welding event, including certification requirements, essential equipment, and key policies to ensure your shop and team are ready.

image.alt: Welder in a bodyshop practicing proper welding techniques after achieving his I-CAR Welding Certification

cards.title: General Requirements
cards.body: Always needed for any welding certification:
listItems: Safety glasses (must be worn at all times)
Leather boots or shoes (no tennis shoes)
cards.footer: Additional items may include a magnifying lens, welding cape or long-sleeve shirt, and a securely mounted vice for destructive-test welds.
